gloss: director (of a museum, library, or similar institution)

definitions.gloss: director; head (of a museum, library, hall, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The person in charge of running a public institution such as a museum, library, art gallery, or cultural hall. The {館|かん} refers to the building or institution.

examples.japanese: {館長|かんちょう}に{挨拶|あいさつ}する。
{新|あたら}しい{館長|かんちょう}が{就任|しゅうにん}した。
{図書館|としょかん}の{館長|かんちょう}が{地域|ちいき}の{読書|どくしょ}イベントを{企画|きかく}した。
examples.english: The library director organized a local reading event.

notes:
Composed of {館|かん} (building, hall) and {長|ちょう} (head, chief). Used for the director or head of any building-based institution: museums, libraries, art galleries, cultural centers, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美術館|びじゅつかん}{館長|かんちょう}: art museum director
- {図書館|としょかん}{館長|かんちょう}: library director
- {博物館|はくぶつかん}{館長|かんちょう}: museum director
- {館長|かんちょう}{就任|しゅうにん}: appointment as director

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
- {官庁|かんちょう}: government office
- {干潮|かんちょう}: low tide
- {間諜|かんちょう}: spy

These are all read かんちょう but written with different kanji, so context and kanji make the meaning clear.
